---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: ['enhancement', 'triage']
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem it Solves

What problem does this feature address? What user need does it serve?

> **Example:** "I'm always frustrated when I have to [...]"

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative approaches? Why is your proposed solution the best fit?

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add sketches, wireframes, or links to similar features in other tools.

## 🌍 Context

- How critical is this to your workflow? (Nice-to-have / Important / Blocker)
- Who else might benefit from this? (All users / Specific use case)

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

What would make this feature complete? (optional, but very helpful)

- [ ] ...
- [ ] ...
- [ ] ...
